title: Intent-phrase JEPA for planning: current evidence and failure-aware roadmap
decision: Treat GAR as the central supported mechanism, report JEPA as competitive rather than superior, invalidate the current deep symbolic-lookahead curve because terminal paths leak through candidate length, and repair that protocol before any five-seed test-time-scaling campaign.
plain_summary: MLP JEPA reaches 0.433 strict success over five seeds and GAR is essential, but sentence-plus-latent prediction leads at 0.521, a one-seed direct ranker matches JEPA, and the apparent deep-planning gain is an evaluation artifact rather than valid test-time scaling.
